# Introduction

Auto-generated from `openapi.json`. Only **public OpenAPI** paths are listed.

- **Generic CLI**: `mett api request …`
- **cURL**: raw HTTP

Environment: `METT_BASE_URL` (default `${METT_BASE_URL:-https://www.gut-microbes.org}`), `METT_JWT` for protected routes, optional `METT_RELEASE`.

::: {.callout-note}
## Friendly CLI

Curated high-level commands live in [Examples](../examples.md) and the [CLI Guide](../cli.md).
:::

# Core APIs

## System

### List METT data releases

`GET /api/releases`

Scientist-visible Elasticsearch release sets. Pass X-METT-Release or ?release=v1 to read an archived or ready set. 'current' follows whichever release is promoted.

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Generic CLI

```bash
mett api request GET /api/releases \
  --format json
```

#### cURL

```bash
curl -X GET "${METT_BASE_URL:-https://www.gut-microbes.org}/api/releases"
```

:::

## Species

### Get all species

`GET /api/species/`

Get all available species

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Generic CLI

```bash
mett api request GET /api/species/ \
  --format json
```

#### cURL

```bash
curl -X GET "${METT_BASE_URL:-https://www.gut-microbes.org}/api/species/"
```

:::

`GET /api/species/{species_acronym}/genomes`

Retrieves genomes under a given species with pagination and sorting.

:::

## Genomes

### Get all genomes

`GET /api/genomes/`

Retrieves a paginated list of all genomes available in the system. Supports optional sorting by 'isolate_name' or 'species'.

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Generic CLI

```bash
mett api request GET /api/genomes/ \
  --format json
```

#### cURL

```bash
curl -X GET "${METT_BASE_URL:-https://www.gut-microbes.org}/api/genomes/"
```

:::

### Get genomes by isolate names

`GET /api/genomes/by-isolate-names`

Retrieves genome records for one or more isolate names. Accepts a comma-separated list of isolate names as input. Useful for batch lookups when isolate identifiers are known.

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Generic CLI

```bash
mett api request GET /api/genomes/by-isolate-names \
  --format json
```

#### cURL

```bash
curl -X GET "${METT_BASE_URL:-https://www.gut-microbes.org}/api/genomes/by-isolate-names"
```

:::

### Search genomes by query

`GET /api/genomes/search`

Searches genomes using a free-text query string. Returns a paginated list of matching genome records. Supports optional sorting by 'isolate_name' or 'species'.

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Generic CLI

```bash
mett api request GET /api/genomes/search \
  --format json
```

#### cURL

```bash
curl -X GET "${METT_BASE_URL:-https://www.gut-microbes.org}/api/genomes/search"
```

:::

### Get all type strains

`GET /api/genomes/type-strains`

Returns a list of genomes that are designated as type strains. Type strains represent reference genomes for a given species and are essential for comparative analysis and classification.

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Generic CLI

```bash
mett api request GET /api/genomes/type-strains \
  --format json
```

#### cURL

```bash
curl -X GET "${METT_BASE_URL:-https://www.gut-microbes.org}/api/genomes/type-strains"
```

:::

### Get all drug data for a strain

`GET /api/genomes/{isolate_name}/drug-data`

Retrieves both drug MIC and metabolism data for a specific strain. Returns comprehensive drug response information including resistance and metabolism patterns. No pagination is applied as this endpoint returns complete datasets for both MIC and metabolism data.

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Generic CLI

```bash
mett api request GET /api/genomes/BU_ATCC8492/drug-data \
  --format json
```

#### cURL

```bash
curl -X GET "${METT_BASE_URL:-https://www.gut-microbes.org}/api/genomes/BU_ATCC8492/drug-data"
```

:::

### Get drug metabolism data for a strain

`GET /api/genomes/{isolate_name}/drug-metabolism`

Retrieves drug metabolism data for a specific strain. Returns paginated degradation percentages, statistical significance, and metabolizer classifications.

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Generic CLI

```bash
mett api request GET /api/genomes/BU_ATCC8492/drug-metabolism \
  --format json
```

#### cURL

```bash
curl -X GET "${METT_BASE_URL:-https://www.gut-microbes.org}/api/genomes/BU_ATCC8492/drug-metabolism"
```

:::

### Get drug MIC data for a strain

`GET /api/genomes/{isolate_name}/drug-mic`

Retrieves drug MIC (Minimum Inhibitory Concentration) data for a specific strain. Returns paginated MIC measurements including drug names, values, units, and experimental conditions.

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Generic CLI

```bash
mett api request GET /api/genomes/BU_ATCC8492/drug-mic \
  --format json
```

#### cURL

```bash
curl -X GET "${METT_BASE_URL:-https://www.gut-microbes.org}/api/genomes/BU_ATCC8492/drug-mic"
```

:::

### Get essentiality data by genome and contig

`GET /api/genomes/{isolate_name}/essentiality/{ref_name}`

Retrieves cached essentiality data for a given genome isolate and reference name (e.g. contig_1). Returns gene essentiality information grouped by contig. This data is typically precomputed and used to visualize gene essentiality in genome browsers or analysis tools.

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Generic CLI

```bash
mett api request GET /api/genomes/BU_ATCC8492/essentiality/contig_1 \
  --format json
```

#### cURL

```bash
curl -X GET "${METT_BASE_URL:-https://www.gut-microbes.org}/api/genomes/BU_ATCC8492/essentiality/contig_1"
```

:::

### Get genes by genome isolate

`GET /api/genomes/{isolate_name}/genes`

Retrieves a paginated list of genes associated with a specific genome isolate. Supports optional sorting by 'isolate_name', 'gene_name', 'alias', 'seq_id', 'locus_tag' and 'product'. Useful for viewing all genes within a selected genome.

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Generic CLI

```bash
mett api request GET /api/genomes/BU_ATCC8492/genes \
  --format json
```

#### cURL

```bash
curl -X GET "${METT_BASE_URL:-https://www.gut-microbes.org}/api/genomes/BU_ATCC8492/genes"
```

:::

### Releases that contain this genome

`GET /api/genomes/{isolate_name}/release-history`

Searches readable METT strain aliases (mett-vN-strains) for this isolate. Does not query mett-current-strains, which would duplicate the promoted version. Each appearance includes that snapshot's annotation pipeline provenance.

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Generic CLI

```bash
mett api request GET /api/genomes/BU_ATCC8492/release-history \
  --format json
```

#### cURL

```bash
curl -X GET "${METT_BASE_URL:-https://www.gut-microbes.org}/api/genomes/BU_ATCC8492/release-history"
```

:::

:::

### Releases that contain this locus tag

`GET /api/genes/{locus_tag}/release-history`

Searches readable METT feature aliases (mett-vN-features) for this locus tag. Does not query mett-current-features, which would duplicate the promoted version. Processing provenance is inherited from the strain document in the same release. Locus tags are not a stable ID across re-annotation: absence in an older release may mean the gene was merged or split, not that the strain was missing.

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Generic CLI

```bash
mett api request GET /api/genes/BU_ATCC8492_00001/release-history \
  --format json
```

#### cURL

```bash
curl -X GET "${METT_BASE_URL:-https://www.gut-microbes.org}/api/genes/BU_ATCC8492_00001/release-history"
```

:::


# Experimental APIs

## Drugs

### Get metabolism data by drug name

`GET /api/drugs/metabolism/by-drug/{drug_name}`

Retrieves metabolism data for a specific drug across all strains. Supports pagination and optional species filtering.

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Generic CLI

```bash
mett api request GET /api/drugs/metabolism/by-drug/amoxicillin \
  --format json
```

#### cURL

```bash
curl -X GET "${METT_BASE_URL:-https://www.gut-microbes.org}/api/drugs/metabolism/by-drug/amoxicillin"
```

:::

### Search drug metabolism data

`GET /api/drugs/metabolism/search`

Search drug metabolism data across all strains. Supports filtering by drug name, class, species, statistical significance, degradation percentages, and experimental conditions. Returns paginated results with detailed metabolism measurements. Note: Sorting is limited to top-level fields (isolate_name, species_acronym, species_scientific_name).

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Generic CLI

```bash
mett api request GET /api/drugs/metabolism/search \
  --format json
```

#### cURL

```bash
curl -X GET "${METT_BASE_URL:-https://www.gut-microbes.org}/api/drugs/metabolism/search"
```

:::

### Get MIC data by drug name

`GET /api/drugs/mic/by-drug/{drug_name}`

Retrieves MIC data for a specific drug across all strains. Supports pagination and optional species filtering.

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Generic CLI

```bash
mett api request GET /api/drugs/mic/by-drug/amoxicillin \
  --format json
```

#### cURL

```bash
curl -X GET "${METT_BASE_URL:-https://www.gut-microbes.org}/api/drugs/mic/by-drug/amoxicillin"
```

:::

### Search drug MIC data

`GET /api/drugs/mic/search`

Search drug MIC (Minimum Inhibitory Concentration) data across all strains. Supports filtering by drug name, class, species, MIC values, and experimental conditions. Returns paginated results with detailed MIC measurements. Note: Sorting is limited to top-level fields (isolate_name, species_acronym, species_scientific_name).

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Generic CLI

```bash
mett api request GET /api/drugs/mic/search \
  --format json
```

#### cURL

```bash
curl -X GET "${METT_BASE_URL:-https://www.gut-microbes.org}/api/drugs/mic/search"
```

:::

# Interactions APIs

## PPI

### Get available PPI data sources

`GET /api/ppi/data-sources`

Get list of available data sources for PPI interactions (e.g., local ES index, STRING DB API).

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Generic CLI

```bash

  --format json
```

#### cURL

```bash

```

:::

### Search protein-protein interactions

`GET /api/ppi/interactions`

Search for protein-protein interactions with various filtering options. Can search by protein_id (UniProt ID) or locus_tag.

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Generic CLI

```bash
mett api request GET /api/ppi/interactions \
  --format json
```

#### cURL

```bash
curl -X GET "${METT_BASE_URL:-https://www.gut-microbes.org}/api/ppi/interactions"
```

:::

### Get PPI interaction by pair ID

`GET /api/ppi/interactions/{pair_id}`

Fetch a single protein-protein interaction including consensus score and all evidence-channel weights for the interaction details panel.

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Generic CLI

```bash
mett api request GET /api/ppi/interactions/bu:A0A0X1ABC1__B0ABC123 \
  --format json
```

#### cURL

```bash
curl -X GET "${METT_BASE_URL:-https://www.gut-microbes.org}/api/ppi/interactions/bu:A0A0X1ABC1__B0ABC123"
```

:::

### Get all protein neighbors (raw data)

`GET /api/ppi/neighbors`

Get all neighbors for a specific protein without algorithm processing. Returns raw interaction data for custom analysis in Jupyter notebooks. Can search by protein_id (UniProt ID) or locus_tag.

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Generic CLI

```bash
mett api request GET /api/ppi/neighbors \
  --format json
```

#### cURL

### Get available score types

`GET /api/ppi/scores/available`

Get list of available score types for PPI filtering. Also returns evidence channel labels for interaction detail panels. Network graphs use the selected score type as edge weight (default: consensus_score); per-channel evidence scores are available when an edge is selected.

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Generic CLI

```bash
mett api request GET /api/ppi/scores/available \
  --format json
```

#### cURL

```bash
curl -X GET "${METT_BASE_URL:-https://www.gut-microbes.org}/api/ppi/scores/available"
```

:::

### Get STRING DB network for PPI pair

`GET /api/ppi/string-network`

Fetch STRING DB interaction network for a PPI pair. Provide either pair_id (lookup from PPI index) or protein_ids (STRING protein IDs directly).

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Generic CLI

